messages.subject: Time recording — April month-end reminder
messages.plaintextBody:
All fee earners,

April time entries must be posted by 5pm tomorrow for month-end billing. Several matters currently show unposted time. Please also review WIP on your open matters and flag anything to be written off or carried forward.

Thank you,
Accounts | Whitfield Carter LLP
